label: Separate MP2/cc-pVTZ stretch-gap comparison
attribution: Generated by Codex under the user's direction.

method.electronic_method: restricted MP2 based on closed-shell RHF
method.geometry: optimize at MP2/cc-pVTZ, then unscaled harmonic modes
method.software: PySCF; installed version and implementation hashes must be recorded before first calculation

selection_reason: A standard correlated wavefunction method distinct from the published semiempirical GFN2-xTB calculation; selected before running, without fitting or method shopping.

primary_gap_test.quantity: antisymmetric stretch minus symmetric stretch, cm^-1
primary_gap_test.reason: Adopt the previously discussed 10 cm^-1 example as this comparison rule (about 9% of the gap), far above the separately required numerical settling tolerance. This is a chosen project criterion, not an established standard or a guarantee of physical accuracy.
primary_gap_test.reference_rounding: Retain the same rounded CCCBDB values used by the published xTB harmonic diagnostic. The separately seen triatomic table gives 3942.5 - 3832.2 = 110.3; do not switch references after seeing results.
primary_gap_test.decision: PASS only if the primary numerical validity checks pass and the finest-step gap falls in the interval. FAIL if numerically valid and outside. INCONCLUSIVE if numerical validity is not established.

secondary_D2O.status: diagnostic only; no gap pass/fail criterion
secondary_D2O.reason: The checked CCCBDB D2O table has fundamental values but no harmonic values. Do not treat its fundamental gap as a like-for-like harmonic reference.

geometry_optimization.coordinates: C2v water with O at origin, H at (+/- r sin(theta/2),0,r cos(theta/2)); q=(r in bohr,theta in radians)
geometry_optimization.algorithm: scipy BFGS using analytic MP2 nuclear gradients and analytic coordinate derivatives
geometry_optimization.primary_geometry: first start; second start is a basin consistency check

hessian.method: central differences of analytic MP2 Cartesian gradients, every Cartesian coordinate; symmetrize only after measuring antisymmetry
hessian.external_modes: remove mass-weighted translations and rotations, retain three internal modes
hessian.independent_check: compare custom external-mode projection with PySCF harmonic_analysis using the same isotope masses
hessian.mode_assignment: classify antisymmetric stretch by opposite O-H bond changes; symmetric stretch is the higher-frequency remaining in-phase mode; report signed gap, not absolute gap

numerical_validity.note: Numerical controls are distinct from the physical-reference gap pass mark.

reporting: Report the outcome even if it fails; do not change basis, method, scale factor or gap criterion in response to the result. No alternative-method reruns except separately registered future work. This is a numerical comparison, not a Lean result.
publication: Local addition only; no publication requested.
